name: context
description: Context-budget tooling for CLAUDE.md. Enforces mechanisable rules at the tool layer (PreToolUse guards) instead of carrying them as resident prose, and reports what a repo's manual actually costs. Inert until a repo declares .claude/guards.toml — enabling it globally is safe. On the host it was built for, it took a session from 9,150 to 1,386 resident tokens (-85%) while making the enforced rules categorical rather than probabilistic.
